Definition: to tinkle, i.e. rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tingle, quiver; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tingle (of ears); 1a2) to quiver (of fear)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
